title: Dictionary of Applied Machine Learning (course edition)

creators.name: Jung, Alexander
creators.affiliation: Department of Computer Science, Aalto University, Finland

description: Open course edition of the Dictionary of Applied Machine Learning: precisely defined, cross-referenced machine-learning terms, each with citations, a typeset PDF, and a Python demo that recomputes what the entry states. Published at https://dictionaryofml.org with machine-readable exports (terms.json, llms.txt) and a companion repository (Colab notebooks, the mldict LaTeX notation package, an MCP server). Distinct from the copyrighted Springer Dictionary of Applied Machine Learning by the same authors.
